pages.title: Getting Around
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() You travel by **building**: trains, airships, submarines, cars and hypertubes.
- **Elytra are off.** One that turns up anyway crumbles into Phantom Membrane.
- Short-range tricks that cost you something, like a double jump or a jetpack tank, stay in.

Here you travel by building. Trains, airships, submarines, cars and hypertubes are how you cross the world, so the shortcuts that make them pointless are switched off.\
\
Short-range tricks that cost you something, like a double jump or a jetpack tank, are still in.

pages.title: No Elytra
pages.text: **Elytra are off.** End City ships have an empty spot where the Elytra used to hang, and no chest, mob or vault drops one. If one turns up anyway, it crumbles into Phantom Membrane. The [#](2E5AAC)[Jetpack](entry://transport/jetpack)[#]() now takes a Shulker Shell instead.

pages.title: Also off
pages.text:
- [#](2E5AAC)[Iron's Spells](entry://exploration/irons_spellbooks)[#](): Portal, Recall, Angel Wings, Portal Frames.
- Artifacts: Warp Drive.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Alex's Caves](entry://exploration/alexs_caves)[#](): the Subterranodon mount, and the Hullbreaker's Enigmatic Engine (so no buildable Submarine).
- [#](2E5AAC)[Tide](entry://fishing/lava_and_void)[#](): the Voidseeker fish, which sent you to your spawn point.

pages.title: Still in
pages.text:
These all stay. Each one is a short hop with a cost or a time limit.

- Ender Pearls
- [#](2E5AAC)[Aether](entry://exploration/aether)[#]() mounts and Valkyrie gear
- [#](2E5AAC)[Artifacts](entry://exploration/gear)[#]()' Helium Flamingo and Cloud in a Bottle
- [#](2E5AAC)[Twilight Forest](entry://exploration/twilight_forest)[#]() gear
- Alex's Caves' Cloak of Darkness

pages.title: Want Elytra back?
pages.text: [#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** A world-wide switch for whoever runs the game. Close the game or server, move **config/paxi/optional/create-galore-with-elytra** into **config/paxi/datapacks**, and start again. Unexplored End Cities and loot have Elytra again. The README has the details.
